observations.body: Paul travels through Macedonia and Troas. After the uproar had ceased, Paul sent for the disciples, took leave of them, and departed to go into Macedonia. For Paul had determined to sail past Ephesus, that he might not have to spend time in Asia; for he was hastening, if it were possible for him, to be in Jerusalem on the day of Pentecost.
